description: QA-Pilot Testing Capability Registry — maps test types to qualified agent capabilities

validator.description: Run Python/shell validator scripts and parse output

contract_check.description: Validate artifacts against JSON schemas or contract definitions

sdk_query.description: Query SDK methods and validate responses

scenario.description: Execute user scenarios with agent guidance or human verification

mcp_api.description: Read-only MCP tool invocation with provenance capture and error taxonomy
mcp_api.limitations: Read-only initially. Write operations deferred to future capability build.

regression.description: Automated regression testing via validators and contract checks
regression.coverage: partial — validators available, SDK queries unavailable

security.description: Security boundary and mutation path testing
security.coverage: partial — validators available, security analysis requires specialized tooling

accessibility.description: WCAG compliance and keyboard navigation testing
accessibility.coverage: unavailable — requires browser automation + a11y evaluation

performance.description: Load time, rendering, and runtime performance testing
performance.coverage: unavailable — requires browser automation + performance metrics

ai.description: AI agent behavior, governance awareness, and hallucination resistance

compliance.description: Compliance framework mapping and evidence verification
compliance.coverage: partial — schema validation available, document review requires human

browser_automation.description: Headless or headed browser execution for HTML test suites

qualified_providers.limitations: Built-in OpenWork browser only, not headless CI

missing.impact: P3 and Q2-C suites cannot execute in static/CI environments

design-taste-frontend.notes: Has pre-flight checklist (50+ items) that could inform accessibility/design testing

frontend-design.notes: Design philosophy guidance, not executable testing

brand-guidelines.notes: Can verify brand color/typography compliance in artifacts

canvas-design.notes: Art generation skill, not testing capability

theme-factory.notes: Can verify theme application in styled artifacts
